changes: Added ProofStory M0-M2 progressive intent hardening CLI commands and docs: original intent snapshots, milestone ledger, diagnostic contract, dry-run coverage/gate checks, process-fact registration, smoke coverage, and no-enforce safeguards.
usage: Use node bin/lattice.js original_intent_snapshot_set/get, milestone_ledger_set/add/get, proofstory_contract_set/get, intent_coverage_check --dryRun, and proofstory_gate_check --dryRun.
expectedOutcome: Users can freeze raw intent, count milestones when triggered, inspect progressive hardening diagnostics, and see warn-only would-block output before DEV without enforcing M3-M9 behavior.
actualTranscript: Build passed, focused ProofStory smoke passed, process fact and orphan checks passed, lattice validate passed 31 commands, and DONE-required validation passed build plus root full test suite.
outcomeDiff: No functional difference from the M0-M2 expectation; diagnostics remain observe/warn only and M3-M9 are intentionally not implemented.
limitations: M3-M9 are not implemented: no intent_collision_set authoring, red evidence creation, spike promotion, DONE intent equivalence enforcement, REVIEW completeness lane, or risk-adaptive enforce.
pitfalls: After merging main, material/story hash drift required rerunning evidence and re-submitting the degraded 3x1 review floor; one reviewer finding on typo false positives was fixed and resolved.
